title: Situation 18, record side: Set the pivot is learned and the learner asks a question that sits inside it. The asked entry marks the skill as asked about after learning, no skill's state changes, and nothing in the reply mentions that mark

turns.say: /ask-mentor Make the rock shake from where the hammer hits.

text.never: after learning|asked about|asked (?:this|that|it) before|you(?:'ve| have)? (?:already )?(?:asked|learned|done|covered)|remember (?:when|how|that)|as we (?:covered|discussed)|last time|once more|one more time

note: Spec 014 T078 (FR-041: for scheduling only; never something the mentor says). Case 20 pins the answer half; this one pins the record half (after_learning) and that the mark never reaches the words. The regex covers FR-041's banned phrases and the same-day variants 'once more' and 'asked it before'. The record starts as case 20's: Set the pivot learned, review not due.
